fusions.name: Loosen the Rivets
fusions.desc: Strikes the target for 5 damage and leaves it 6% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Shed a Layer
fusions.desc: Releases a ring of force that deals 7 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. It holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Layered Aegis
fusions.desc: Raises a shell of mana plates that absorbs the next 24 damage, up to 4 blows, for 8 seconds, and raises your armour by 8%.

fusions.name: Glyph-Etched Plate
fusions.desc: Conjures plate etched with warding glyphs: every hit you take is 2 lower, your armour rises by 10%, your arcane resistance rises by 10%, and 6% of the damage you take goes back to whoever dealt it.
